description: Hi! I'm a Computer Science sophomore interested in AI, programming, data analysis, and space exploration. I hope to collaborate with passionate people to build innovative solutions for real-world challenges. Our team plans to develop a Lunar Landing Site Navigator using NASA open data. We're looking for teammates with skills in Python, AI/ML, web development, 3D visualization, data science, or UI/UX design. Creativity, teamwork, and enthusiasm are always welcome!
